title: Refund policy
text: Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refundable, but you can cancel anytime and keep access until the end of the billing period.

title: Download invoices
text: Invoices are available as PDFs under Settings > Billing > Invoice History. Admins can add a billing email so invoices are copied to finance.

title: Upgrade or downgrade your plan
text: Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal.

title: Failed payments
text: If a card payment fails, we retry 3 times over 7 days. Update your card under Settings > Billing > Payment method to avoid suspension.

title: Reset your password
text: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page. A reset link is emailed to you and expires after 1 hour. SSO users must reset through their identity provider.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Enable 2FA under Settings > Security using an authenticator app. Save the 10 backup codes. If you lose both your device and your codes, an account admin must reset 2FA for you.

title: Invite teammates
text: Admins can invite up to 50 users on the Team plan under Settings > Members. Invites expire after 7 days.

title: Delete your account
text: Only the account owner can delete an account, under Settings > Account > Delete. Data is permanently removed after 30 days.

title: API rate limits
text: The API allows 100 requests per minute per key on the Team plan and 1,000 on Enterprise. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429. Retry using the Retry-After header.

title: Rotate API keys
text: Create and revoke API keys under Settings > Developers. Revoked keys stop working immediately. We recommend rotating keys every 90 days.

title: Service status
text: Live status and incident history are at status.acme.example. Subscribe there for email or SMS updates.

title: Export your data
text: Owners can export all workspace data as CSV or JSON under Settings > Account > Export. Large exports are emailed as a download link within 24 hours.

title: Uptime SLA
text: Enterprise plans include a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA with service credits. Team plans do not include an SLA.

title: Supported browsers
text: We support the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported.
